newsitem.title: GERMANY: AT&T appoints new president for Europe.
newsitem.headline: AT&T appoints new president for Europe.

text.p: AT&T Corp, the U.S. telecommunications giant, said on Monday it has appointed Robert Aquilina as president of its operations in Europe, the Middle East and Africa.

"His tasks will particularly involve responsibility for AT&T's investments in alliances and partnerships in this region," the company's German subsidiary said in a statement announcing the appointment.

Aquilina was previously head of development of residential customer products at AT&T Laboratories and most recently vice president in charge of voice and data communications services for business customers.
